item.title: Version 2.5.0
item.description:
Two additions in this release:
Download subtitles online — for any video that doesn't have them. Pick a language from the captions menu (or Playback ▸ Download Subtitle) and Opal fetches a matching subtitle from SUBDL, saves it next to the video, and loads it right away. Needs a free SUBDL API key, which Opal asks for once (create an account at subdl.com and copy your key from the API page).
Episode list for video — a season folder or playlist now gets a glass side panel (the film-strip button in the control bar) listing every file with the current one highlighted; tap to jump. The Up Next card leads by 2 minutes on long videos so it appears during the end credits.
